regime_context: US thematic detector as of 2026-07-23 shows a broad rotation (63% eligible) with Memory/HBM leading (score 4.74, fading tag). The ONE validated edge is absolute-trend drawdown avoidance; cross-sectional momentum rank-IC ~0. Themes with strongest durability/trend (Cybersecurity, Managed Care, Energy, Financials) carry lower shake-out risk, while many late-cycle themes are ineligible. Crowding flags on several leaders are sizing cautions only.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity exhibits the highest durability_bar (0.82) with a trend tag and strong breadth (0.8), aligning with the detector’s validated absolute-trend gate for drawdown control. While crowded (z=1.83), that flag is a sizing caution, not a fade signal. The risk-adjusted staying-power characteristics support an overweight lean, but small-sample track record and mixed macro backdrop keep conviction low.
evidence: absolute-trend gate historically reduces drawdowns in US market (gate_helps: true)
theses.dissent: High crowding may reflect crowded positioning; any shift in risk appetite or a cyber-specific shock could trigger sharp reversals that the trend label cannot foresee.

falsifier.text: Durability bar drops below 0.60 OR breadth falls below 0.50, indicating a loss of trend cohesion and invalidating the drawdown-avoidance thesis.

theses.subject: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Communication Services is ineligible (trend gate not met) with a durability_bar of 0.14, mean-reverting hurst tag, and very narrow breadth (0.217). The validated drawdown-avoidance edge argues that ineligible themes carry elevated shake-out risk. Avoiding such themes aligns with the risk-control discipline, even though cross-sectional return forecasting is not the detector’s strength.
evidence: eligible: false, durability_bar: 0.14, hurst_tag: mean-revert, breadth: 0.217 (rank 39)
absolute-trend gate helps cut drawdowns on ineligible themes (gate_helps: true)
theses.dissent: The sector could be deeply oversold; a mean-reversion rally would leave the underweight lean underperforming. The detector’s momentum rank-IC is ~0, so a negative score does not predict further weakness.

falsifier.text: Eligibility flips to true AND durability_bar rises above 0.50, suggesting the gate no longer flags elevated drawdown risk.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
